What is real today?

Current availability of the app and website preview
ExperienceCurrent status
Native app
In testing		The Watch learning experience and iPhone parent experience include questions, discoveries, stories, early math, family topic preferences and activity reports. These features are present in current app source and are still being tested. Activity reporting does not yet include every offline experience.
Website preview
Illustrative		Prepared content and original recorded narration. The Moon preference, listening pace and completed-sample list work in this browser preview only; they are not a promise of identical native controls. No live AI, microphone capture or child account.
Public release
Still ahead		Compatibility, onboarding and parent controls need release validation. App-specific privacy disclosures, provider practices, retention, consent and account deletion also need verification. No public release date or pricing is announced.

The website demonstrates the concept. It does not establish that every native behavior, safeguard or data-handling process has been verified.

About the app.

The initial product focuses on ages 4–5, with the child experience on Apple Watch and a parent experience on iPhone. A public App Store release, launch date and subscription pricing have not been announced on this website.

Before buying a device: the current beta uses a Watch normally paired with an iPhone. Apple Family Setup onboarding has not been verified for this beta. Please confirm release compatibility before purchasing hardware for TrustinJr.

The app is not positioned as a school-time device. Follow your school’s device policies. Audio-first also does not mean screen-free: the app includes pictures, reading text and touch interactions.

Help shape what comes next.

What would help your child discover more while keeping you involved? Parents can email the project with feedback, availability questions, or device questions. Please do not include a child’s personal information.
